title: School curriculum pallet flips (GovDeals + ChatGPT sort)
one_liner: Win near-zero-bid school surplus curriculum pallets on GovDeals/PublicSurplus, ID publishers via vision+LLM on listing photos, sell complete sets on eBay to teachers/homeschoolers.
why_agent_runnable: Auction monitoring, photo-ID of Heinemann/Saxon/Abeka/etc., comps, and eBay listing drafts are agent-native. Brandon gates bids, freight pickup, and listing publish.

ops_steps.title: Auction watchlist
ops_steps.detail: Track GovDeals/PublicSurplus school surplus book/curriculum lots; flag low competition + clear photos.

ops_steps.title: Vision ID + comps
ops_steps.detail: Screenshot listing photos → ID titles/publishers; pull eBay sold comps for complete teacher/student sets.

ops_steps.title: Brandon capital + category box
ops_steps.detail: Set max bid, storage, and allowed publishers; complete auction KYC.

ops_steps.title: Bid memo
ops_steps.detail: Propose bid ceiling from comps minus fees/shipping/risk; no bid without Brandon money gate.

ops_steps.title: Receive + sort sheet
ops_steps.detail: Checklist for pickup/freight; agent builds set inventory from Brandon photos.

ops_steps.title: eBay listing pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft complete-set listings with grade/publisher keywords; Brandon publishes.

ops_steps.title: Sell-through review
ops_steps.detail: Log velocity by publisher; kill weak categories; propose next auction.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.set_sell_range_anecdote_usd: $50-400 per curriculum set cited — anecdote only
unit_economics_sketch.fees_notes: eBay + PayPal/managed payments + shipping eat margin; prefer complete sets
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Photo quality and set completeness drive outcomes. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: watchlist of live school surplus lots
Day 3: vision ID + comps on top 5
Day 7: Brandon go/no-go on first bid (money gate)
kill_criteria: No lots with identifiable high-demand publishers after 2 weeks monitoring
First pallet sell-through too slow vs storage cost after 45 days
Shipping damage / incomplete sets wipe contribution
